summary.headline: intimate celebration
summary.oneParagraphVision: Bring 100 people together in Mumbai for a modern, elegant wedding. Build the celebration around catering, venue, decor, with a practical budget and a clear path to the big day. Your chosen traditions and dietary needs guide the details; confirm these with your vendors.
keyRisks: Multi-day wedding (2 days) — budget is spread across functions. Consider prioritizing key functions.
assumptions: All prices are planning estimates; obtain written local quotes.
Confirm accessibility, food allergies and local permissions with your vendors.
Confirm ceremony timing and any muhurat with your chosen officiant.

warnings: Multi-day wedding (2 days) — budget is spread across functions. Consider prioritizing key functions.

vendors.why: The venue sets the tone for your entire wedding. It affects decor, logistics, guest comfort, and photo aesthetics. Ranges are rough India-market planning estimates, shown in your selected currency using illustrative conversion; they are not local or live quotes. Obtain local written estimates.

checklist.text: Visit venue at the same time of day as your event
Confirm capacity for guest count + vendors
Check parking availability and accessibility
Ask about noise restrictions and curfew
Confirm backup plan for outdoor spaces (rain/heat)
Review included amenities (tables, chairs, AV, AC)
Check generator/power backup availability
Verify washroom facilities and cleanliness
Ask about vendor restrictions (outside caterer, DJ allowed?)
Confirm decoration and setup time windows
Check guest accommodation options nearby
Review insurance requirements
Confirm step-free access and accessible facilities
Agree the exact scope and itemized tax-inclusive estimate
Confirm cancellation, postponement and refund terms

questionsToAsk: What is included in the venue rental fee?
Are there any date-specific surcharges (weekends, holidays)?
What is the cancellation policy and refund timeline?
Can we extend the event time if needed, and at what cost?
Do you have an in-house coordinator or a preferred vendor list?
How many other events will be hosted on the same day?
What are the power/electricity arrangements?
Is the venue accessible for elderly guests and those with disabilities?
What is included and excluded in the written quote?
What taxes, travel and overtime costs apply?
Who provides emergency backup?
How do you provide accessible service?
What are the cancellation and postponement terms?
Which permits and insurance do you hold?
Who is our named day-of contact?
How are changes and final approval documented?
redFlags: No written contract or vague terms
Demands more than 50% non-refundable deposit upfront
Refuses to allow an in-person visit before booking
No clear cancellation or force majeure policy
Won't share insurance or safety certifications
No written contract or itemized quote
Pressure to pay the entire amount upfront
Unclear cancellation and refund policy
No backup plan or named contact
Refusal to document safety and accessibility responsibilities
contractMustHaves: Exact date, time, and duration of booking
Complete list of included items and services

ideas.title: Food Donation Partnership
ideas.description: Partner with a local food bank to donate surplus food. Plan portions carefully to minimize waste while ensuring enough for guests.

ideas.title: Inclusive Event Design
ideas.description: Ensure wheelchair access, sign language interpreter, large-print programs, sensory-friendly quiet zone, and dietary labels.

ideas.title: Live Chaat Counter
ideas.description: Interactive chaat station with pani puri, bhel, dahi puri, and sev puri — customizable toppings for each guest.
ideas.whyItFits: Supports your vegetarian dietary needs. Budget-friendly option.

ideas.title: Minimalist Elegance
ideas.description: Clean lines, monochrome palette with a single accent color, geometric shapes, and curated simplicity.
ideas.whyItFits: Matches your modern, elegant vibe. Easy to implement. Budget-friendly option.
